# Franki Chamaki

> Official website and professional hub for Franki Chamaki, a Sydney-based AI Growth Marketer and GTM Systems Builder.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.frankichamaki.com/) - AI growth marketing, GTM systems, demand generation and selected outcomes
- [About Franki Chamaki](https://www.frankichamaki.com/about/) - Background, experience, working approach and tools
- [AI & GTM Systems Projects](https://www.frankichamaki.com/projects/) - Index of documented AI and GTM builds

## Documented AI & GTM builds
- [Contact Intel](https://www.frankichamaki.com/projects/contact-intel/) - Claude-powered pre-call intelligence used in Slack, combining HubSpot history, Clay growth signals and live company and sector news
- [Target Account Intelligence Agent](https://www.frankichamaki.com/projects/target-account-intelligence/) - Clay, Apify and Claude workflow monitoring growth signals across 146 target accounts and posting weekly Slack briefs
- [EngineRoom](https://www.frankichamaki.com/projects/engineroom/) - AI-assisted event follow-up from badge scan to HubSpot enrichment, follow-up brief and Gmail draft

## Professional project
- [GTM Sprint](https://gtmsprint.run/) - GTM experiments and support for solo founders
